title: A Horizon for the Machine Anew
author: Yara Lockridge
blurb: Xanthe Ishikawa, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
